items.text:
For the price and enjoying 40-50hours of gameplay why not. Thats if you want to salvage ships and piece a new one together using spare parts.

Still missing features last I played, combat was a bit wonky and I think the exercise equipment had just been added so you could actually improve your character. Hopefully more of that will get fleshed out, as it didnt make too much sense that I couldnt better myself after the choose-your-own-adventure character creation.

Would be nice to see multiple ships docked at a single location to make it a bit more lively, the ability to heal those npcs that are dying, multiple level ships could be fun if the engine supports it.... maybe some larger areas to explore. A more restrained 'special event' spread... thats was getting very annoying. A form of food growing perhaps - plenty of room for additional crafting mechanics or extra items for salvage, some ships only seemed worth grabbing the engines in terms of time vs value.
items.text_zh:
就这个价格和能享受40-50小时的游戏时间来说，为什么不呢。前提是你想打捞飞船并用备件拼凑出一艘新的。

我上次玩的时候还缺少一些功能，战斗有点别扭，我记得健身器材刚加进去，这样你就能真正提升角色了。希望这些能进一步完善，因为在我自己选择冒险式的角色创建之后却不能提升自己，这不太合理。

如果能在一个地点看到多艘飞船停靠，让它更有生气就好了，能治疗那些濒死的NPC，如果引擎支持的话，多层级飞船可能会很有趣……也许还有一些更大的区域可以探索。更克制的“特殊事件”分布……那玩意儿变得非常烦人。也许可以有种种植食物的方式——有大量空间可以加入额外的制作机制或打捞物品，有些飞船从时间与价值比来看似乎只值得拿走引擎。

observations.description: 特殊事件分布过于密集令人烦躁
